important_rules: Use header tables for document numbers, dates, patient identity, service status, and care context.
Use detail tables for service items, medicines, or medical procedures per document.
Use history tables only when the user explicitly asks for service history or audit changes.
Many M11 documents revolve around patient visits; check the relationship to `KJ` first when the context is a service episode.
Because healthcare is sensitive, readonly query output must avoid unsupported clinical assumptions.

caution_areas: Questions that mix billing, medical records, and clinical services without separating the source document.
Questions that use history tables together with active tables without a clear audit purpose.
Sensitive healthcare questions that risk extrapolating clinical meaning beyond the structured data.
